tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ /pu tra 'cham gyi brjed tho bstan srung dgyes pa'i rnga sgra bzhugs/ /oṃ swasti sid+dham̐/ 'dir pu tra 'cham gyi brjed byang la/ thog mar lam 'gros khams gsum zil gnon la/ bzhi brdungs chung ba gsum dang che ba gsum gyi 'cham tshul rnams rdzogs mtshams/ rol mo 'then rkang shin tu che ba bzhi'i 'then rkang gsum pa'i skabs/ rkang g.yon btegs shing yong phyogs la gom brdzus kyis mchongs pa'i tshe/ rkang g.yas 'phar chung byed pa 'di ma chad pa dgos zhes bdag gi bla ma rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can nyid yang yang gsungs pa lags/ de nas gnod sbyin yab kyi gcig brdungs nyi ma'i zhags pa la/ gcig brdungs dang po la kha do ra'i nang la blta/ gnyis pa la mdun nas g.yas phyogs bskor te kha yong phyogs blta/ gsum pa la kha phyir blta'o/ /bzhi pa la de dang 'dra zhing / lnga pa la kha yong phyogs bskor la de phyogs la blta ba dang / drug pa la kha do ra'i nang la blta ba ste/ de 'dra ba lcags 'then sogs kyis mtshams ma bcad pa tshar gsum ste rol mo bco brgyad kyi bar bya'o/ /gnod sbyin mo'i nyis 'gros zla ba'i 'od zer ni/ nyis brdungs dang po gnyis la kha 'gro phyogs dang / rjes ma gnyis la mdun nas g.yas la bskor te kha yong phyogs la blta ba res mos so/ /pu tra'i gsum brdungs khams gsum dbang bsdud la/ gsum brdungs dang po la kha 'gro phyogs la blta zhing pad bskor bya/ gsum brdungs gnyis pa la mdun phyogs nas g.yas la bskor te kha yong phyogs la blta zhing lag g.yas phyir bsgrengs/ gsum brdungs gsum pa la kha yong phyogs la bltas pa de'i ngang nas mdun nas bskor te pad skor dang bcas kha 'gro phyogs blta/ gsum brdungs bzhi pa la kha mdun nas g.yas phyogs bskor/ lag g.yon nang la bsgrengs shing kha yong phyogs blta ba'o/ /bha ṭa'i bzhi brdungs gling bzhi zil gnon ni/ bzhi brdungs dang po la kha nang la bltas pad bskor bya zhing /

bzhi brdungs gnyis pa la mdun nas g.yas phyogs bskor kha yong phyogs bltas la rol pa bya/ bzhi brdungs gsum pa la kha phyir bltas la pad bskor bya/ bzhi brdungs bzhi pa la yong phyogs nas bskor kha nang la blta/ sked gzer lag pa gnyis kas bya'o/ /sring mo'i lnga brdungs sku lnga khro sprul ni/ rol mo che ba lnga la kha yongs phyogs blta zhing g.yas bskor dang / chung ba lnga la kha blta tshul de kha'i ngang nas rim par brgyud de g.yon bskor bya/ yang rol mo che ba lnga la kha 'gro phyogs blta zhing g.yon bskor bya zhing kha blta phyogs de ga'i ngang nas rim par brgyud de chung ba lnga la g.yas bskor bya/ de 'dra ba'i lnga brdung che ba bzhi dang chung ba bzhi bya'o/ /de lta bu'i 'cham tshul lnga ka'i bar mtshams rnams su yang pad bskor gsum dang bcas lcags 'then lus kyi dbus/ g.yon/ g.yas/ yang rol mo 'theng brdungs gnyis la g.yon dang g.yas su lcags 'then byas rjes bzhi 'gros ji ltar rigs pa dang / yang gong bzhin gyi pad bskor lcags 'then rnams byas la 'cham dngos gzhi rnams la 'jug cing / gnod sbyin yab kyi gcig brdungs kyi mgor/ lam 'gros khams gsum zil gnon gyi 'cham pa rnams kyi do ra 'khor zhing / 'cham dpon dbus su phebs pa dang pad bskor gsum dang lcags 'then rnams grub 'phral bzhi 'gros mi byed par gcig brdungs la 'jug pa yin la/ sring mo'i lnga brdungs kyi mjug tu pad bskor lcags 'then rnams dang bzhi 'gros ji ltar rigs pa grub pa dang / liṅga la dgug gzhug lha dbye mdzad rjes rol mo si li li ber blang ba'i ring ba gsum la/ lus g.yas log g.yon log yang g.yas log rnams byas la pad bskor lcags 'then gong bzhin gyi lcags 'then grub 'phral rol mo'i mjug ring tsam byas bzhag ste/ bzhi 'gros mi mdzad par/ dpang gzugs/ 'das dang ma/ dpal ldan mgon po sogs kyi gdangs dang bstun seng gdong ma'i drug brdungs zhi ba'i lcags kyu ni/

kha rgyab la bltas nas hūm̐ bh+yoḥl bca' gzhi tsam byas la/ gcig ge gnyis la lag gnyis mdun du kha phub/ gsum mo bzhi la lag gnyis g.yas su brkyangs la gan rkyal bsgyel/ lnga drug la lag gnyis dpung g.yon steng 'phyar/ yang gcig ge gnyis la rkang g.yas btegs kha mdun la bltas lag gnyis mdun du kha phub/ gsum mo bzhi la lag gnyis g.yon du brkyangs la gan rkyal bsgyel/ lnga drug la lag gnyis dpung g.yas steng phyar/ 'di bzhin byas na rdzogs mtshams gnon pa la 'grig go /tshigs bcad 'di rnams kyi gdangs thung du btang pa dang 'cham pa rnams ling ga la je nye je nyer btud/ de nas gzig gdong ma'i bdun brdungs rgyas pa'i zhags pa ni/ bdun brdungs dang po la kha phyi la bltas te mchongs/ bdun brdungs gnyis pa la 'gro phyogs la mchongs/ bdun brdungs gsum pa la yong phyogs la mchongs/ bdun brdungs bzhi pa la kha nang la bltas liṅga'i phyogs la mchongs/ bdun brdungs lnga pa la g.yas bskor/ bdun brdungs drug pa la g.yon bskor/ bdun brdungs bdun pa la nang liṅga'i phyogs la mchongs pa'o/ /de nas tshigs bcad rnams rdzogs rjes/ rol mo chems brdungs dang bcas liṅga bsgral/ de mthun bud med nag mo rnams hob rgyugs su byas te ling ro blangs nas rol chen rnga chung pa dang bcas te log de nas rol mo gsum brdeg gcig byas nas bzhag de rjes dge slong / sngags pa/ skyes chen/ skyes chung pa rnams rnga chung pa dang bcas te log tshar ba dang / rol chen chems brdungs bcams pa'i rjes/ rol mo si li li ber blangs pa'i ring ba gsum la g.yas log g.yon log g.yas log byas rjes rol mo bzhag la/ de nas dom gdong ma'i brgyad brdungs dbang gi lcags sgrog ni/ phyi nang gsang ba ma'i gdangs dang bcas 'cham pa ste/ dbyangs kyi hūm̐ 'dren bzhi ka la rkang g.yas brkyang 'deg cing / tshig dang po la yong phyogs phyin te do ra'i nang la mchongs/

tshig gnyis pa la 'gro phyogs phyin te do ra'i phyi la mchongs/ tshig gsum pa la g.yas nas bskor/ yang 'gro phyogs la phyin te kha do ra'i phyi la bltas te yong phyogs mchongs/ tshig bzhi pa la yong phyogs phyin te kha nang la bltas nas g.yon la mchongs tshul tsam byas nas/ ba'i ya'i zhes pa dang dgu brdungs blangs te 'cham dpon gyis sna drangs te pu tra ba rnams log 'byon pa'i dgu brdungs 'di ni dred gdong ma'i dgu brdungs drag po'i dril chen no/ /'di'i phyi nang gsang ba'i hūm̐ 'dren bzhi la rkang g.yas btegs la lus g.yas phyogs rkyang la bskor/ tshig rkang snga phyi gnyis la g.yas bskor ha cang che ba mi dgos shing / tshig rkang bar ma gnyis la g.yas bskor che ba tsam dgos la/ tshig rkang bzhi ka'i tshig gi 'bru dang po thams cad la rkang g.yas sa la phab tshig 'bru gnyis pa thams cad la rkang g.yon brkyangs/ 'degs pa dus mtshungs par byas pas 'grig pa yin no/ /zhes pa pu tra 'cham gyi brjed tho nyung ngu 'di yang rang lo bcu bdun lon tshe bka' drin can gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po de nyid kyis 'di skor gyi 'cham tshul rnams bzhi thog dpe khang du nged rang gcig pu la phyag khrid zhib cha dang bcas gnang ba la/ rang nyid brjed ngas che ba'i dus phyis the tshom cung zad za ba rnams sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i 'cham dpe dang / 'jam dbyangs mthu stobs dbang phyug dpon slob rnams la 'dra bsdur zhus dag bgyis te dag par byas nas/ sa skya pa sngags 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis rang gi brjed byang du sbyar ba 'dis bstan srung dbang po rnams dgyes par gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 4 a myes zhabs/ putra 'cham gyi brjed tho bstan srung dgyes pa'i rnga sgra/
